# Major

#### Feat

- [POTENTIALLY BREAKING] Pagination is no longer synchronised when multiple plugins are on a single page (#94). The first plugin with pagination enabled keeps the route enhanced `/page-X`; further paginated plugins use `pages[<content uid>]` in the query string. Overridden `List/Pagination` partials should use `a:paginationArguments` (see the Templates documentation)

# Patch

#### Fix

- Resolve orphaned and incorrect pagination values
- The "Maximum pagination links" plugin setting is now respected (the controller was reading a non-existent `maximumLinks` setting)
- Pagination links now keep the active filters, so changing page no longer resets a filtered list
